computer-org.title: Digital Logic & Computer Organization
computer-org.description: Build a computer from logic gates up: number representation, assembly language, CPU pipelines, caches, and virtual memory.
computer-org.audience: For learners who want to understand exactly how hardware executes software.
computer-org.goal: Explain and reason about how a program runs on a processor and why memory behavior dominates performance.
